title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide your body with enough iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of your baby. However, finding recipes rich in iron and folate can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, which can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of your baby's brain and nervous system. Vitamin C also plays a vital role in enhancing iron absorption.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Grill the chicken in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Water Spinach Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup water spinach
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Stir-fry the beef in a pan with oil and seasoning. Cook the rice and water spinach in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Tofu and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g tofu
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Cook the tofu in boiling water. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to ensure food safety. Make sure all ingredients are cooked thoroughly and there's no risk of bacterial contamination. [Visit our website for more information on food safety](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner).

## Conclusion
The three recipes above are excellent options for pregnant women who want to provide their bodies with enough iron and folate. Remember to always ensure food safety and visit our website for more information on prenatal nutrition and [meal planning](/planner).
